description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LDAPServiceAnonBindTest' which tests LDAP anonymous binding functionality within the OrangeHRM system. It sets up LDAP server configuration, enables anonymous binding, loads test fixture data, and includes tests for anonymous connection and configuration changes with different permission levels.

classes.name: LDAPServiceAnonBindTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying LDAP anonymous binding functionality, including configuration modifications and permission-related test cases within the OrangeHRM LDAP module.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup before any tests run; checks LDAP server configuration and skips tests if not configured.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment before each test, configuring LDAP server and loading test data if not already done.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Sets LDAP server settings, enables anonymous binding, sets server page size, and loads test LDAP user fixtures.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests establishing an LDAP connection without explicit credentials to verify anonymous authentication works.

methods.name: testChangeGlobalConfigUsingAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Attempts to modify LDAP global configuration attributes with an anonymous bind, expecting failure.

methods.name: testChangeGlobalConfigUsingAdminUser
methods.description: Attempts to modify LDAP global configuration attributes with admin credentials, expecting specific errors based on permissions.
